description:
Subject: Full‑Stack Software Development Position – San Francisco, CA  

We are excited to announce an opening for a full‑stack software developer based in San Francisco, CA. The role focuses on JavaScript‑driven development within an Agile methodology framework, requiring strong experience in designing and consuming REST APIs. Candidates should be comfortable contributing across the entire software development lifecycle, from initial design through deployment and maintenance.  

The compensation package is competitive, with a salary range of $85,000 to $120,000 per year, reflective of the expertise and impact expected in this position. If you are passionate about full‑stack development and thrive in a collaborative, Agile environment, we encourage you to apply.
